archimate:ArchimateDiagramModel.name: Supporting Value Stream: Governance and Compliance
archimate:ArchimateDiagramModel.documentation:
Purpose and Description The Governance and Compliance Value Stream ensures that all activities within the statistical organization are performed within a coherent framework of legal, ethical, methodological, and quality standards. It provides the mechanisms by which statistical processes, data assets, and outputs are governed, documented, and audited. This value stream safeguards trust, accountability, and transparency, ensuring compliance with regulations such as GDPR, national statistical laws, and international frameworks (UNECE, Eurostat, ISO).
It operates continuously, underpinning all core value streams by defining the “rules of the game” that govern statistical production.
